author: Cecily Harcourt
html: Nice write-up — clear and practical. Quick question: when you run the reference renderer in headless Chrome, do you version-lock the dotlottie-wc/thorvg engine used to generate the committed reference frames so CI stays stable over time? If not, could drifting reference builds cause false failures?

author: Frank Delporte
html:
Good remark! Indeed the web-renderer has a locked version, see https://github.com/lottie4j/lottie4j/blob/main/fxfileviewer/src/main/java/com/lottie4j/fxfileviewer/render/DotLottieFrameRenderer.java#L52.

Evolutions in the format and the rendered can indeed cause drifting differences. Definitely something to keep an eye on for me… 😉
